links.outcome: Readability of LLM responses (Flesch-Kincaid, Gunning Fog, SMOG, Flesch Reading Ease)
links.effect: Flesch-Kincaid Grade Level 14.03 (Copilot) to 15.66 (Perplexity); Gunning Fog 15.15 to 18.13; SMOG 14.69 to 16.49; Flesch Reading Ease low across all models, highest 20.71 (Copilot).
links.quote: The Flesch Reading Ease scores were low across all models, with Copilot showing the highest score of 20.71.

links.outcome: Concordance of LLM answers with 2014 JNS lumbar fusion guidelines
links.effect: Concordance 66.67% ChatGPT 4o, 58.33% Perplexity, 54.17% Gemini, 50% Copilot; non-concordant answers were insufficient or over-conclusive (Copilot 37.5% over-conclusive).
links.quote: ChatGPT 4o had the highest concordance rate at 66.67%, with non-concordant responses distributed at 16.67% for both insufficient and over-conclusive classifications.

screen.reason: Empirical benchmarking study evaluating the concordance and readability of multiple commercial LLMs on guideline-based spine fusion clinical questions.
